change trail: patches of customers/users call audit function
change trail: deletes from customers/users call audit function

change control: tests assert anonymous calls rejected (params none)

change approvals (someone other than the author approved the change before release)
evidence that a review or approval happened (records, dates, sign-off)

assumptions: customers and users are the tables whose changes must be audited (customers is in workspace; users table exists); other tables not audited
admin API group (canonical admin) is the admin surface; app/admin/stats lives in app group and is not covered by AUTH-002
check_admin_role is the role-check function name (exists in workspace)
CC6.1/CC6.3/CC8.1 are the SOC 2 criteria I mapped to; these are my labels, not verified against the auditor's list
confusions: AUTH-002 template fills by tags [admin] but no endpoint has an admin tag; unclear whether to change scope to api_groups or propose the tag. I chose api_groups and flagged it.

Recipe 'Record who changed what' says extra rules go in one policy with own key, but the skill also says one policy per template; I put RET-001 in its own policy and the extra audit rules in AUDIT-TRAIL-COVERAGE. Unclear if that is the intended split.
Template key rule: a custom key must not share a template prefix with a number no template has; I used AUDIT-TRAIL-COVERAGE (no hyphen-number), which I assumed is acceptable.
object.statement_required 'when' takes one statement; to cover edit, patch and delete I needed three rules. Not obvious from the catalogue that a multi-statement list is not allowed in when.
No guidance on whether 'change control' in a SOC 2 sense should map to tests or to audit trail; the catalogue labels CHG-001 as change management but it only checks tests exist.
The skill says never claim compliance; the reply needed to explain that without sounding like a refusal, and there is no template text for non-technical customers.
wished_for: A recipe for 'access review evidence' that says explicitly it cannot be done in policy, with a pointer to what the customer should collect instead
A template or check for change approval (e.g. a required approval function before a blocking merge), or a clear statement that none exists
Guidance on mapping SOC 2 criteria to tags, ideally from the platform, so tags are not my guesses
Confirmation whether when.statement can take a list, or an example of a multi-statement audit rule
Example of an admin tag convention or how to scope by API group in AUTH-002's template
why_confidence: The policies do cover the parts of change control that exist as workspace definitions (audit trail of edits to customers/users, audit-table write restriction, login and admin role-check on endpoints, and tests). They cannot prove access reviews or change approvals happened, which is the core of the ask. Policies were not evaluated or pushed (forbidden for this task), so I have no observed findings; the outcome of each rule is a prediction from reading the workspace files.
